title: Dispatch: per-source executable evidence model for all 31 rows (attempt 4)
description:
Human review of PR #477 at f2e7891 accepted the previous corrections but found six
further defects. The supervisor independently confirmed the two most serious in
the code. This is an evidence-model re-architecture, not six patches.

=== FILES YOU OWN ===
  docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/bootstrap-capability-ledger.json
  docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/bootstrap-capability-ledger.md
  docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2n1t-engine-closure-reconciliation.md
  packages/core/src/rules/bootstrapCapabilityLedger.ts
  packages/core/test/bootstrapCapabilityLedger.test.ts

=== SUPERVISOR-CONFIRMED DEFECT 1: THE EVALUATOR ONLY SEES MAGIC ITEMS ===
bootstrapCapabilityLedger.ts reads `record.data.executionReadiness` as its sole
executable evidence. In the committed pack `executionReadiness` exists on
MAGIC-ITEM RECORDS ONLY — verified against
packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/records.json. So every row
across engine:F1..F10, including rest/time, downtime/currency, hit-point
lifecycle and geometry primitives, is "proved" by a magic-item-only evaluator.
The ledger claims five sources and proves one, narrowly.

=== SUPERVISOR-CONFIRMED DEFECT 2: UNCONSTRAINED SUBSTRING MATCHING ===
Hook matching is `text.includes(term.toLowerCase())` over free text. That will
assign hooks to the wrong primitive on near-matches, prefixes, suffixes, and
unrelated strings containing the token. "table" matches "comfortable";
"pool" matches "whirlpool"; "reset" matches "preset".

=== SUPERVISOR EVIDENCE MODEL — replace packEvidence entirely ===
A row carries an ARRAY of evidence items, each a discriminated union member with
its OWN executable resolver and its OWN expected-result semantics:

  { kind:'readiness-artifact', queryId, engine, hookSelector, expected }
      hookSelector uses EXACT structured hook identity — match
      engineHooks[].engine exactly and the hook's structured id/name exactly.
      No substring matching over free text. Ever.
  { kind:'code', queryId, module, symbol, expected }
      resolver proves the named symbol/site actually exists in @eshyra/core.
  { kind:'bead', beadId, expected }
      resolver checks via bd, SKIPPING GRACEFULLY when the binary is absent —
      keep the existing skip discipline, do not make the suite need bd.
  { kind:'audit-finding', findingAlias, expected }
      findingAlias must be fully qualified (engine:/fable:/opus:/sol:/indep:)
      and must resolve to a known finding.
  { kind:'known-missing-source-clause', sourceRef, locator, expected:'absent-from-pack' }
      must POSITIVELY PROVE absence from the pack, not merely return nothing.

Rules:
* Every row names at least one executable evidence item, or an explicit,
  reviewed non-query evidence method with a stated reason.
* A row's evidence must come from the source APPROPRIATE TO THAT ROW. A
  magic-item readiness query is not evidence for a rest/time primitive.
* EXPECTED-RESULT SEMANTICS ARE PER EVIDENCE KIND. Fail when a required baseline
  membership is unexpectedly empty; when a query is malformed or points at the
  wrong source; when a primitive has no independently grounded evidence; or when
  the evaluator never exercised the row. An empty result must never silently
  pass. Approved source-missing primitives may legitimately have no pack hook —
  but they must carry non-pack evidence AND prove the absence is expected.

=== QUERY IDENTITY BINDING ===
Validation must reject: unknown query IDs; duplicate or ambiguous query
ownership; a query used for a different primitive without explicit reviewed
multi-ownership; rows with neither an executable query nor a reviewed non-query
method; and evaluator results that cannot be traced back to their row.
Positional, implicit, or family-level association is inadequate.

=== PRIMITIVE-LEVEL SPECIFICITY ===
Three rows presented as primitive-level currently query or return whole engine
families. Family membership may GROUP, but never substitutes for primitive
identity or exact affected membership. Review ALL 31 ROWS for this failure mode,
not only the three observed.

=== SHARED SOURCE-OBLIGATION IDENTITY (binding across #475, #476, #477) ===
  obligationId := "obl:<sourceRef>:<locator>:<facet>"
EVIDENCE KIND closed union, shared conceptually:
  'source-span' | 'authoritative-input' | 'audit-finding' | 'code' | 'bead'
  | 'known-missing-source-clause'
Do NOT overload one `sourceSpan` field to represent incompatible evidence
types — that is exactly the current defect. Distinguish exact source span,
authoritative non-PDF input, audit-finding identity, code evidence, bead
evidence, and known-missing source clause.
Do NOT import code from the #475 or #476 branches; align concepts, duplicate the
small types locally, and record the temporary duplication and integration
boundary in bootstrap-capability-ledger.md.

=== PRESERVE — reverify, do not regress ===
The PREMATURE / OVERSTATED UMBRELLA CLOSURE classification of eshyra-2n1t and
its supporting argument; corrective routing of .6/.7/.9/.12 to the four child
beads; proposed-row ownership representability with its positive test; the
pinned seven non-pack primitives; recursive stored-total rejection. Keep their
tests. The legendary-action-budget row must remain demonstrable evidence that
the bootstrap method escapes pack-derived blind spots.

=== ENVIRONMENT AND VERIFICATION ===
Run `npm ci` FIRST. Run `npm run verify:worktree` BEFORE committing — it
rewrites files. If rulesPackAuditCli or dolt-gated suites time out under load,
rerun that file in isolation before concluding a regression.

=== HARD CONSTRAINTS ===
* Edit ONLY the files above. Do not touch package.json,
  packages/core/package.json, packages/core/src/internal.ts, AGENTS.md,
  CLAUDE.md, .github/, or any script/protocol/CI file. Review infrastructure is
  OUT OF SCOPE this session.
* Do NOT regenerate the rules pack, run the importer, or edit packages/core/data.
* Do NOT create, reopen, or close any bead except your own. Do NOT run
  `bd dolt push`. Do NOT push, comment on a PR, or merge.
* Where a committed test encodes defective behavior, change it deliberately and
  record why. Never delete a test to make a finding disappear.
acceptance_criteria:
• Evidence is a per-source discriminated union with its own resolver and expected-result semantics; no magic-item readiness query is used as evidence for a non-magic-item primitive.
• Hook matching uses exact structured identity; negative tests cover near-matches, prefixes, suffixes, and unrelated strings containing the token.
• Every row binds to a named query identity; unknown, duplicate, ambiguous, untraceable, or missing query bindings are rejected.
• Empty results never silently pass; each evidence kind defines when empty is valid, and source-missing primitives positively prove expected absence.
• All 31 rows reviewed for family-substitution; every primitive row has primitive-specific evidence.
• Evidence kinds are distinct; sourceSpan is no longer overloaded; the shared cross-PR identity is used and the deferred integration boundary is documented.
• Umbrella-closure classification, .6/.7/.9/.12 routing, proposed-row representability, the seven non-pack primitives, and recursive count rejection are preserved with tests.
• npm run verify:worktree passes.
notes: Completion report: Replaced the single magic-item-only packEvidence query with a row-owned evidence array for all 31 primitive rows. Updated the bootstrap evidence documentation and retained the 2n1t reconciliation artifact unchanged. Decision disagreement: none. Obligations not satisfied: none; #475/#476 integration remains the documented deferred boundary, with the small local type duplication required by this correction.
